text: follow-on: the map edit's producing mechanism is not durable. The evidence fragment cites the write script only by its path in the run directory (apply_outliers.py), which is run-scoped and not committed to the repository; the committed fragment and test cannot reproduce the exact write, and a later reader has no committed artifact recording how the seven evidence strings were composed (the clause wording, the uniqueness guard on the evidence token, and the non-evidence-field assertion all live only there). The map edit itself is preserved (soft-fact) by the superseded copy and the sha pair, so the loss is provenance of the transformation, not the data. Suggested follow-on: land the script under scripts/ (or fold its clause builder into the test module) so the transformation is reproducible from the tree.

follow-on: the run's manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null while it produced both gate logs and lists them under test_logs (logs/baseline-gate.log at revision 6839ec1f, 38 passed EXIT=0; logs/head-gate.log at revision 27a38082, 39 passed EXIT=0). The done-when asks the review to derive added_failure_count/ids from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs; those logs exist and are readable and complete (both reach their summary line), so this review derived them from test_logs instead, but a consumer that reads only the baseline_suite/after_suite keys sees an unreadable (null) arm. Record-shape follow-on for the coordinator: the manifest should carry the armed-only JSON for both arms.

follow-on: loop 16's E100595 outlier rests on r = 0.9497, which is 0.0003 inside the |r| > 0.95 pass boundary, so a regenerated per-shot fit could move the classification across the threshold and change which loops carry an outlier. The RCA table itself does not bold this fit (a fail), so the node's classification is the source's own and the fragment discloses the boundary case; no change is warranted now, but the tolerance is thin, so a future fit regeneration should re-check loop 16 specifically.

justifications.durability: The committed test and fragment are landed with a conventional subject and a substantive body; the superseded map copy is kept under superseded/pre-verdict-outliers with a sha256 matching the fragment's before value; the transform asserts every non-evidence field byte-identical. justifications.fit: The node implements the plan's own decision vacuum-verdict-rule (section 6): 'Per-shot outliers are recorded beside each verdict rather than hidden.' It touches nothing the plan did not ask for, keeps every rule corpus-validated (the median rule fixes the sign over three shots), leaves names/COCOS/positions untouched, and its evidence wording ties the outlier to the reference-7 fit the RCA measured. One point off for a thin-threshold robustness note (finding 0.9497 vs 0.95 boundary, finding 3).
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node does exactly its dispatched goal: the seven corpus-validated differential loop rules whose per-shot fit fails on a vacuum shot now name that shot with slope and r in their evidence, and a test asserts the transcription. The set is complete and correct (loops 18-26 pass all shots; loop 7 is the reference). Held one point off for two follow-ons noted in findings (the producing script is uncommitted; the manifest leaves both suite arms null), neither of which changes the delivered data.
justifications.reuse: Reuses the RCA's per-shot table as the source and the existing test module and helpers (_rules_for, FLUX_LOOP_PATH, the corpus-validated loop tuple) rather than inventing a parallel path; the clause builder is a small dedicated function. Held two points because the (loop, shot, slope, r) table is duplicated as a literal in both the producing script and the test (a divergence risk), and the transform asserts I could not exercise (the source-of-truth is the map in both).
justifications.scope_discipline: Exactly the declared write paths were written; the map diff is confined to seven evidence strings; the test file change is purely additive (+37, one function, no edits to existing assertions); the fragment is new. No production code, no unrelated bundle field, no committed regression guard disturbed. Full marks.
